listing.name: Gravity Rush 2 — Gravity Rush2 PC (HayatoG) (HayatoG)
listing.summary: Upstream reports image, audio and controls at 30 FPS on Linux with an RTX 2060. This is separate from Prathewsh’s multi-title runtime. Saves and open-world gameplay are still being tested; geometry outlines are off by default. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted CUSA03694 dump with update 01.11. Audio also needs your own libSceNgs2.sprx from console firmware.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the native runtime release or follow the source launcher instructions to import your own game data.

warnings: Upstream reports image, audio and controls at 30 FPS on Linux with an RTX 2060. This is separate from Prathewsh’s multi-title runtime. Saves and open-world gameplay are still being tested; geometry outlines are off by default.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
